component.name: Fake IMAP Server
component.summary: Accepts any IMAP request and replies with an empty response
接受任意 IMAP 请求并进行空应答

description.p: Fake IMAP Server is a tiny mock IMAP service intended for testing. It listens on a TCP port, greets clients like a real IMAP server, and answers every command with an empty "OK" response without doing anything.
Fake IMAP Server 是一个用于测试的微型假 IMAP 服务。它监听一个 TCP 端口， 像真实 IMAP 服务器一样发送问候，然后对任何命令都只返回空的 OK 应答。
A small GTK4 window shows that the server is running; closing the window terminates the process.
